summary.content:
Today's selection covers 112 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 76 on Artificial Intelligence and 19 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Prepares to File for an I.P.O. in Coming Weeks
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Hackers bypass SonicWall VPN MFA due to incomplete patching
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, The Verge, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 57 articles published in the last 24 hours
